Code inspection PASS, preview baseline PASS, override precedence PROVEN via functional probe (DB_NAME_OVERRIDE=testercheck_db routed a fresh registered user into testercheck_db and NOT realtalk_db), full revert completed and validated. Regression suite (7 tests) passed before AND after the override probe. No regression, no leftover state.
critical_code_review_comments: Override loop (server.py L46-52) correctly runs immediately after load_dotenv, uses os.environ.get with str+strip, ignores empty/unset values, and writes into os.environ so all downstream readers (routes/db.py, utils/email_service.py, services/*) receive the promoted MONGO_URL/DB_NAME. Behavior is idempotent and safe.

Preview .env has both MONGO_URL_OVERRIDE="" and DB_NAME_OVERRIDE="" (empty), so preview is unchanged and the keys are still capturable by the Emergent Publishing Secrets panel (they are non-reserved names).
No changes needed. This is a clean, minimal, well-scoped patch.

rca of the issue: Not a bug — this iteration is a verification of a deployment-configuration fix. Root cause of the original problem: Emergent Publishing panel reserves MONGO_URL and DB_NAME so operators cannot inject production DB values via the Secrets UI. Mitigation implemented by main agent: a two-line override loop after load_dotenv that promotes the non-reserved *_OVERRIDE keys into MONGO_URL/DB_NAME at process start. Empty overrides are ignored, so preview remains 100% unchanged. Functional proof: setting DB_NAME_OVERRIDE="testercheck_db" then restarting backend caused a fresh /api/auth/register call to persist in testercheck_db (1 doc) and not in realtalk_db (0 docs). Reverting to empty restored realtalk_db as the active DB (admin login 200).
